The managed llama serve process binds only to 127.0.0.1 and uses a random current-user API key. Worktrail calls the local API first and enters a lock-protected recovery path only when the API is unavailable.
Use worktrail search --semantic=required "task" for strict semantic search. Context Pack semantic selection may affect knowledge sections only; state and current handoffs remain deterministic.
An active semantic generation is opened through a read-only immutable SQLite URI after a query acquires its generation lease. The query closes the connection before releasing the lease.

A semantic bundle is content-addressed by the SHA-256 of its canonical trusted manifest. The manifest pins the BGE-M3 Q8_0 GGUF, llama.app runtime variant, CLS pooling, L2 normalization, and sqlite-vec cosine profile. Candidate generations build beside the active generation and atomically activate after validation.
Pending knowledge candidates require explicit human review before promotion. Evidence is not formal knowledge.
